authorization.scope: make the completed point-in-time historical B0-versus-B1 study primary while retaining prospective v2.3 unchanged as secondary replication

research_question: Does conservatively point-in-time, market-relevant Lumid news improve prediction and calibration of 30-minute absolute canonical-YES prediction-market repricing beyond executed-market history?

study_positioning.secondary: unchanged prospective EventX v2.3 protocol-validation replication

windows.split_basis: 80/20 complete UTC days fixed by the label-blind feasibility protocol

source_policy.source_claim: complete bounded retrieval of rows present in the Lumid warehouse, not completeness of the global news universe

cohort.selection_rule: include every market with earliest Lumid metadata available before development close, a unique canonical YES outcome, at least 100 canonical-YES development trades, and at least 10 development active UTC days

news_availability.primary_time: max(published_at, ingest_ts, joined provenance.runs.started_at, joined provenance.runs.ended_at when present)
news_availability.missing_run_end: allowed because max includes ingest_ts after the verified run start

news_association.symbol_mapping: frozen association rule; news_symbol_mapped is one only where a frozen canonical financial-symbol mapping exists, otherwise zero

price.primary: latest canonical-YES executed trade at or before each five-minute UTC grid time
price.canonical_yes_polymarket: price for the unique YES asset_id
price.candles: not permitted for primary labels or market features

labels.threshold_semantics: inherited preregistered heuristic anchored in one-minute sigma units, not four horizon-standard deviations
labels.future_price: latest canonical-YES trade at or before t+30m

learner.standardization: training rows only within each fold
learner.prediction: arithmetic mean probability across the three fixed seeds

development_validation.type: five purged expanding-time folds with disjoint held-out market groups
development_validation.market_group: integer value of sha256(venue + ':' + market_id) modulo 5
development_validation.training_rows: eligible rows strictly before validation_start minus 30 minutes from all market groups except the held-out group
development_validation.validation_rows: eligible rows in the fold interval from only the held-out group

uncertainty.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap within market over out-of-fold predictions
uncertainty.estimand: conditional on the frozen market cohort

promotion_gate.h3: both improvements positive in at least four of five folds
promotion_gate.h4: paired bootstrap 95% lower bound for Brier(B0)-Brier(B1)>0
promotion_gate.h5: Brier(B0)-Brier(B1)>=0 separately for Kalshi and Polymarket
promotion_gate.fallback: freeze B0 if any condition is unsatisfied

one_shot_holdout.selection: B1 only if all development H1-H5 pass, otherwise B0
one_shot_holdout.final_model_training: selected specification fitted once on all eligible development rows with fixed seeds
one_shot_holdout.claim_scope: the frozen historical cohort and interval

execution_order: retrieve_and_hash_development trades while keeping holdout prices sealed
pass_and_freeze exact development trade and feature data gate
construct development labels and run B0 versus B1 exactly once
freeze at most one candidate and its hash
materialise or unseal historical holdout and write consumption receipt
evaluate the frozen candidate exactly once
retain prospective v2.3 as an unchanged secondary replication
